wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 04-001 creates the single frozen runtime artifact every downstream subsystem (asset loaders, render init, audio init, save format, demo player, intermission, HUD, automap) reads to derive its own per-tic state. The runtime context wires the LaunchContext from 03-004, the IwadResourceCache from 05-001, flattened GameIdentification fields for ergonomic access, a fixed-size MAXPLAYERS=4 playerSlots array (each slot frozen with present=false/player=null), an initially-empty mapState, an initially-silent audioState, a vanilla initial uiState (HUD visible, automap/menu closed, no intermission), and two zero-filled 320x200 indexed framebuffers (primary + back) matching vanilla screens[0] and screens[1] from r_main.c. The top-level object is frozen; nested mutable buffers follow the vanilla d_main.c in-place-fill pattern with stable object identity.
